##### Project general facts

Aum 99 Residences by AG Properties is a contemporary residential building that rises above two basement parking levels and a ground floor to a rooftop amenity deck. The project offers studio, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, each planned to make the most of space, light and everyday functionality. A striking double-height entrance with a tiled floor and quality fittings opens into an elegant reception, while a well-designed lift lobby with high-speed lifts provides smooth access to every level.

Amenities are concentrated on the rooftop, where residents can enjoy a swimming pool with a sun lounge and open sky views. A dedicated children's pool with its own lounge offers a safe and playful space for families. The rooftop gym features glass walls and modern exercise equipment, combining workouts with city views. Smart covered parking across the ground and basement floors provides secure entry and efficient allocation, adding everyday convenience for residents and their guests.

Interiors reflect a calm, contemporary aesthetic with durable finishes and carefully chosen materials. Kitchens feature clean lines, high-grade fittings, durable worktops and concealed storage, with open layouts in selected homes. Bedrooms are designed for privacy and rest, living rooms work equally well for family time and hosting, and bathrooms are finished with top-quality fixtures and fittings. Apartments are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's choice.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubailand Residence Complex is a residential community within the wider Dubailand district, close to Global Village, Arabian Ranches and Dubai Miracle Garden. It offers a quieter setting with a mix of apartment buildings, parks and everyday services, while keeping some of Dubai's best-known leisure destinations within a short drive. Neighbouring districts such as Majan and Liwan add further retail, schools and green spaces.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road connect the community with Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, Dubai International Airport and Business Bay. Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, Burj Al Arab and Emirates Hills are also within easy reach, as are Al Maktoum International Airport and Jebel Ali Port. Residents have access to schools, clinics, supermarkets and shopping centres throughout the surrounding communities.

Dubailand Residence Complex is a freehold area that attracts first-time buyers and investors looking for accessible entry points close to Dubai's main road network. Steady demand from young professionals and small families supports rental yields that compare well with more central districts. The steady development of neighbouring communities strengthens the area's appeal for long-term ownership.
